_comment: Independent public-input witness for hack.c check_special_room() (hack.c:3654-3770) reached from dothrow.c hurtle_step() through uhitm.c mhitm_knockback(): a dwarvish Valkyrie on the Oracle level waits outside the Delphi doorway while two ettin zombies attack, and one knocks her into the doorway. The port dry-runs that monster turn on a clone first; the clone must keep its own u.urooms[]/u.uentered[] and its own Delphi subroom, or the live entry finds the room already entered and loses the greeting.
